data.body: HOOKS_AUDIT: HOOKS-REFERENCE.md updated with 5 new subsections — review-sub-pr workflow (DSO_SUPPRESS_PRIOR_DEFENSES), merge-pipeline-checks + red-test-blocker, llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh (OVER_BOUND routing), check-fp-recovery-eligibility.sh, and worktree-removal-guards.sh. CI-INTEGRATION.md received ADR 0016 cross-link in version-bump section. CLAUDE.md.no.changes.needed: all new hooks/scripts are implementation-detail signals, not per-session decision rules. OVER_BOUND and DSO_SUPPRESS_PRIOR_DEFENSES are CI env vars documented in CI-INTEGRATION.md/HOOKS-REFERENCE.md — no CLAUDE.md entry warranted. review-sub-pr and merge-pipeline-checks are required-check names referenced in CI-INTEGRATION.md — CLAUDE.md already links to CI-INTEGRATION.md.
